training.dataset: hotel-booking-demand (Antonio, Almeida & Nunes, Data in Brief 22, 2019)
training.population: deposit_type == "No Deposit", market_segment != "Undefined", distribution_channel != "Undefined", adults >= 1, stays_in_weekend_nights + stays_in_week_nights >= 1; children NaN -> 0; meal Undefined -> SC
training.split: by arrival date: train < 2016-07-01 <= validation < 2017-01-01 <= test
